Meet Max

I didn’t want to be on social media either.

For over 20 years, I built my business face to face, one handshake at a time. In 2021, my sister finally convinced me to post one video. It wasn’t polished or planned, and it did better than anything I expected.

Once I started showing up consistently, posts turned into conversations, and conversations turned into clients: more than 30 of them and 11 partnerships in 18 months, without spending a dollar on ads.

Posts 2 Profits is everything I learned, written for business owners and entrepreneurs who would rather serve people than perform for them.

How it actually works

I never pitched her once.

A friend from high school watched my posts for months without ever saying a word. No likes. No comments. Nothing.

Then she hit a problem she couldn’t solve on her own. She needed real help, fast, and she was worried about what it would cost.

She could have called anyone she knew. She messaged me. We got on the phone that afternoon, I helped her get exactly what she needed, and she’s been a client ever since.

No single post won her over. Months of everyday posts made me the first person she thought of.
